about: Global brand rules. Apply to every output. Format profiles in data/formats/ may tighten these but never loosen them; rules with locked=true cannot be overridden at all. 'source' says where in the Figma file 'Design MCP' each rule comes from.

rules.rule: Use the blue logo on white and light-themed backgrounds.
Use the white logo on dark-themed backgrounds and on brand-coloured backgrounds.
Only two typefaces exist: TASA Orbiter and Inter. No third typeface may be referenced anywhere, including as a fallback. If TASA Orbiter is unavailable, fall back to Inter and stop there.
TASA Orbiter is for headings and display type only. Never use it for body copy, and never mix the two roles.
rules.source: Typefaces frame; Variable description: family/heading; Uploaded token files 2026-10-09 (typography.json: 'TASA Orbiter for headings only … Never mix')

rules.rule: Inter is for body copy, labels, captions and eyebrows only. Never use it for headings (except as TASA Orbiter's fallback).
rules.source: Typefaces frame; Variable description: family/body; Uploaded token files 2026-10-09 (typography.json)

rules.rule: Text uses one of the defined text styles (Display, Heading, Body, Eyebrow); no in-between sizes.
Never set type below 10px, at any breakpoint.
Font sizes are whole pixels only. No fractional sizes.
Weights run from Regular (400) to Bold (700). Thin, ExtraLight, Light, ExtraBold and Black are banned in every family.

Every Display, Heading and Body style comes in Regular, Medium, Semi Bold and Bold (e.g. Heading/H2/Bold, Body/MD/Medium). Use the named weight variant rather than changing the weight by hand; the base style's weight is the default. Eyebrow is the exception: Medium, or Semi Bold only.
rules.source: Text style weight variants in Figma, requested by brand team 2026-10-09

rules.rule: Eyebrows are Inter, 10px / 16px, ALL CAPS, colour text/eyebrow. Weight is Medium (500) by default; Semi Bold (600) is the only alternative.
rules.source: Text style 'Eyebrow'; Variable description: weight/eyebrow, size/eyebrow; size confirmed by brand team 2026-10-09

rules.rule: Body copy sizes (Body/XL 20px down to Body/2XS 10px) default to Inter Regular and have no letter spacing (0) at any weight.
rules.source: Text styles Body/* (0% tracking, Regular); Uploaded token files 2026-10-09 (typography.json: 'Inter Regular, no tracking')

rules.rule: Inter has a large body scale on the same size steps as the TASA Orbiter headings: Body/72, 60, 48, 40, 32 and 24 (desktop), shrinking on mobile like the headings, with -1% letter spacing. Use it for big statements, stats and pull quotes set in the body face; use TASA Orbiter Display/Heading styles for actual headings.
rules.source: Text styles Body/72–Body/24 and size/body/* variables; scale requested by brand team 2026-10-09

rules.rule: Base body size (body/md, 16px) does not shrink on mobile.
When writing to Figma, use each family's exact style names: TASA Orbiter uses 'SemiBold' (no space); Inter uses 'Semi Bold' (with a space). They are not interchangeable.
Every colour comes from the colour tokens; prefer semantic tokens. Never sample a colour from an image or pick a near neighbour.
rules.source: Semantic Colours frame (every value aliases a Global Colors primitive)

rules.rule: Every page or screen root uses background/primary, with no border. Override only when a specific colour is requested.

Headings (h1–h6) use text/heading (#0C1927 Light, #F1F5FA Dark); body copy uses text/body (#243547 Light, #CBD5E2 Dark); eyebrows use text/eyebrow (brand/500 Light, brand/300 Dark). Never use text/heading for body copy.
rules.source: Variable description: text/heading, text/body, text/eyebrow; eyebrow colour confirmed by brand team 2026-10-09; heading/body colours from colors.json, decided by brand team 2026-10-09

rules.rule: text/primary is a legacy alias of text/body. Use text/body in new work.

Fills and text go in fixed pairs: brand fills (background/brand, container/brand, primary button) take text/on-brand; inverse surfaces take text/inverse; success surfaces take text/success; error surfaces take text/error; accent fills take text/on-accent.
The default container (cards, panels, sheets) is container/primary with a 1px border/container edge. A container nested inside it uses container/secondary; a third level uses container/tertiary.
rules.source: Variable description: container/primary, container/secondary, container/tertiary, border/container; card borders decided by brand team 2026-10-09

rules.rule: Success and error containers have no border.
Default containers already have a 1px border/container edge. border/primary is opt-in, for a stronger border: inputs, table dividers, or when a request explicitly calls for one.
Eyebrow text may only sit on background/primary, container/primary, background/brand-subtle or container/selected. It fails contrast on container/secondary and container/tertiary.
Eyebrows are always small text: they need 4.5:1 contrast; the 3:1 large-text exemption never applies.
Accent is a highlight, not a palette: keep it to roughly 10–15% of any asset, counting fills and accent text together, so it never competes with brand blue.
rules.source: Variable description: background/accent, container/accent, text/on-accent, border/accent, text/accent

rules.rule: Text on an accent fill uses text/on-accent (near black). White text on accent fails.

text/accent is permitted only on a dark ground with verified 4.5:1 contrast. Light theme: only on background/inverse or container/inverse. Dark theme: on standard dark surfaces, but never on background/inverse, container/inverse or brand fills.
text/placeholder is for input placeholder text only, never for real content.
border/error is never the only error signal; always pair it with text/error.
Never remove the focus ring (border/focus) without an equivalent visible indicator.
Spacing uses the uniform 4px scale from 4 to 56. No 2px, no odd values; if a design wants 6px or 14px, round to the scale.
rules.source: Variable description: global/spacing/*; Uploaded token files 2026-10-09 (spacing.json)

rules.rule: Pick spacing by purpose: gap/inline between adjacent items (icon and label, chips), gap/stack between stacked elements in a component, gap/grid between cards in a grid, padding/container inside cards and panels, padding/section between page sections. gap/grid and padding/section tighten on mobile.

Corners are softened, not rounded: surfaces use radius 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 or 12px. The default is 2px (radius/default); 12px is the largest radius on any surface. There is no 0: square corners mean no radius set.
rules.source: Variable description: radius/default, radius/3xl; Uploaded token files 2026-10-09 (radius.json)

rules.rule: Pill radius (9999px) is only for chips, tags, badges, avatars and circular icon buttons. Never on a card, panel, container, input or image.
rules.source: Variable description: radius/pill; Uploaded token files 2026-10-09 (radius.json)

rules.rule: Every border is 1px (border-width/default) unless stated otherwise. Thicker steps are 2px (emphasis, selected), 3px (strong emphasis) and 4px (the maximum). There is no 0 and no fractional width: to remove a border, remove the stroke.
rules.source: Variable description: border-width/*, global/border-width/*; Uploaded token files 2026-10-09 (borders-elevation.json)

rules.rule: Surfaces are flat by default (Elevation/None). Low Raised lifts cards off the canvas; Mid Raised is for modals and popovers only, on container/elevated. Elevation is carried by the shadow, which is the same in Light and Dark.
rules.source: Effect styles; Variable description: container/elevated; Uploaded token files 2026-10-09 (borders-elevation.json); Mid Raised scope per borders-elevation.json, decided by brand team 2026-10-09

rules.rule: Never combine a shadow with a heavy border (2px or more) on the same surface. Shadows are identical in Light and Dark.
rules.source: data/sources/uploaded-2026-10-09/borders-elevation.json; 'heavy' = 2px or more, decided by brand team 2026-10-09

rules.rule: Everything is fully opaque unless stated otherwise. Use opacity/overlay (48%) for scrims behind modals and image overlays, opacity/muted (72%) for de-emphasised content, opacity/subtle (32%) for faint washes.
